scope: Bounded foundation convergence: native tool context, memory lifecycle, retrieval, SDK protocol and Mac/WSL portability. This is not an exhaustive landscape or a global install list.

rounds.selection: Five SDK/memory/Mac embedding comparators plus three pinned discovery lists. Inspect implementation and targeted regression tests, not README scores.
rounds.actionable_result: Embedding identity/mixed-index migration, scope-before-ranking and protocol-cancellation contracts remain useful gaps. No replacement justified for the accepted record of memory.

quality_criteria: maintenance/release dates separated from measured quality
method.stopping_evidence: Two bounded rounds completed. The screened challengers add conditional capabilities but none justifies a second durable store or unmeasured encoder upgrade. Three benchmark/workflow leads remain discovery-only, so universal saturation is explicitly not claimed.
method.public_star_audit: Parent-owned full-star enumeration is an identity audit only; this lane uses the prior decision index for membership and does not count it as deep source review.

repositories.rationale: The disposable native 2.3.1 fixture closes a routing/TTL/ingestion-time lifecycle evidence gap without changing the accepted store. Retain one cross-harness memory of record.
repositories.limitations: TTL hides default search but an exact-path read still returns expired content until sweep. Deletion removes current/as_of retrieval, not necessarily Git or backup history. Autonomous improvement remains off; require_approval defaults false in inspected source when a configured reviewer is used.
repositories.platform_evidence: Actual Linux/WSL Bubblewrap+native stdio acceptance. Mac/Windows require their own isolation and native run.

repositories.gap_addressed: Native hook context budget and raw recovery
repositories.rationale: Keep native client/cache/tool-discovery behavior. Reviewed hook spiller caps model-visible additional context at a default approximate 2500 tokens and retains a full-file recovery path when writing succeeds.
repositories.limitations: A zero limit disables the cap. A spill-write failure falls back to truncation without a saved full artifact. Reviewed main moved seven commits beyond the prior snapshot while stable remains 0.155.1; no new-main feature is claimed installed. UI preview changes are not provider token savings.
repositories.platform_evidence: Existing native Linux CLI/paired worker acceptance remains historical. No fresh Desktop/macOS hook run in this lane.

repositories.gap_addressed: Preserve native settings, hooks and bounded tool access in workers
repositories.rationale: Transport source omits setting-sources when unset, passes an empty list as --setting-sources=, and maps tools=[] to an empty base tool set. Skills options can default settings to user/project. Make worker policy explicit rather than assuming SDK defaults match native CLI.
repositories.limitations: allowed_tools expresses approval patterns, not the available base tool set. Settings selection is not filesystem isolation. Windows transport refuses .cmd/.bat and prefers native executables. GitHub release 0.2.156 differs from publisher PyPI 0.2.157; neither is installed by this review.
repositories.platform_evidence: Native Claude headless workflow already accepted separately. Selected Windows transport code and provider-backed upstream E2E tests are source evidence; no provider call was made here.

repositories.gap_addressed: MCP cancellation, concurrency and protocol-version compatibility
repositories.rationale: A strong transport-conformance reference for future reusable tool adapters. Source tests correlate concurrent out-of-order responses and exercise cancellation/session survival across transports.
repositories.limitations: The inspected v2-era Client/MCPServer surface differs from older SDK integrations. Legacy streamable HTTP cancellation has a terminal error response; newer/stream transports can abandon without one. Do not upgrade an installed integration transitively without its own contract replay.
repositories.platform_evidence: Python >=3.10; selected tests are platform-neutral protocol contracts. No SDK install, transport service, or runtime upgrade executed.

repositories.platform_evidence: Upstream cross-client platform instructions; no local install or Mac/Windows execution. PostgreSQL/SQLite deployment choice remains conditional.

repositories.gap_addressed: Embedding identity migration and superseded-memory filtering
repositories.rationale: Useful migration comparator: memory-bank records identify their embedding model, mismatch degrades to text matching, and source tests separate supersession filtering from similarity using a stub encoder.
repositories.limitations: Upstream explicitly states the RAG index does not detect mixed models and must be rebuilt too. Re-embedding, index rebuild and service/cache restart are a coupled operation; partial failures can leave stale vectors. Published machine-labelled scores are not our quality proof. Do not run eval-recall against live configuration during a supposedly offline review.
repositories.platform_evidence: Go and Homebrew/macOS operational examples, plus local-only configuration tests. No daemon install, encoder call or live-bank access here.
